result.summary: Page is largely intact with no critical breakage. Found 3 minor visual inconsistencies: inconsistent favorite-icon background, truncated carousel text, and flush time badges.

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no dark circular background/scrim while the pizza card below it does, making the first icon low-contrast and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark translucent circular background behind all favorite icons in the Popular list for visibility and consistency.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in Fastest near you is cut mid-word at the screen edge without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel items use proper text truncation with ellipsis and sufficient end padding so text does not appear abruptly clipped.

issues.description: Delivery-time pills (15-25 min, 20-30 min) sit flush against left/bottom edges of the Fastest near you images with almost no inset padding.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent inset margin so pills are fully contained within the image with rounded-corner padding.
